answer: One concrete mechanism: bind each identity to one scarce resource bought at market price, because lotus only stays cheap while the attacker's cost scales linearly with fleet size while payout per identity stays flat. Concretely, oasis is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any falcon approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
